notes: LV: only 1 eligible with an EUR price: FoxiFood (stored d03a6e1f, food_truck; Latvian-language site, food-truck page, pre-orders for a chosen date and time, no monthly fee + 2% + 0,45 EUR per order; operator Elite Digital Services, LLC, USA, country-terms page lists Latvia). No Latvian-made customer online-ordering tool with a public price was found: SIA UCS (r_keeper dealer, Riga) shows only cashier-taken takeaway pre-orders; Trinity (trinity.lv) builds custom ordering systems, no price (not opened); TIAMO FOOD is a restaurant chain's own app; Dativa Wendoapp is supplier ordering. Multi-country tools with Latvian pages, checked and not relevant: IQ Rest (table ordering only), ShopWidget (Serbian generic web shop). Multi-country European tools with Latvian pages that I did NOT open because they are not on my readable list (they look like agent 1's 'any European multi-country tool'): MenuForma (stored b70bbf5e, menuforma.com/lv — free plan said to include online ordering + takeaway, paid 8,99 €/month per search snippet), GASTRODIGITAL (stored 9ed5a6b1, gastrodigital.global/lv/cenas — 32–49 € per till excl. PVN per snippet). Food Truck Pub (stored 18f621da) appeared only as App Store listings; not opened. Round-1 dead ends not repeated: MEALS, CompuCash, NRdata, PapaPos.
